Two members of [[SolSeed]], [[Patrick]] and [[Eric]], attended Ottawa's Pride Parade on August 24th, 2014.  [[Patrick]] marched with the Unitarians while Eric pedaled the SolSeed PrideMobile in loops beside and around them.

[[File:SolSeedPrideMobile.jpg 400px]]

The PrideMobile was simple Eric's bike with three copies of the Pride Poster attached to the milk crate on the back:

[[File:PridePoster.jpg  400px]]
